content.name: base60
content.zero_rule: Zero MUST be explicit as a digit 0 (no omission).
content.place_order_rule: Places are ordered left-to-right from highest place to lowest place.
content.no_collapse_rule: Representations must not trim, collapse, or omit internal zero places.
rendering_separation: No glyphs or symbols are part of base60 numeric representation.
Glyph rendering is defined in a separate pack that depends on this pack.
